title: Handbook of the Counterweight Box
summary: Teaches cultivators to fill balance and hang the counterweight box of a fixed-weight trebuchet and to throw with qi-steadied hands.

title: A Practice of the Hinged Weight
summary: Shows trained cultivators how a hinged counterweight swings free of the arm and how to time the throw to its fall.

title: Treatise on Throwing from the Whip
summary: Instructs strong cultivators in the whip throw where the sling cord is cast around the arm tip for the longest flight.

title: Drill-Book of the Lowered Release Angle
summary: Drills a shortened pin hook for a low flat throw at close ranks and the crouch that keeps the crew safe.

title: Canon of the Traction Team Under Qi
summary: Teaches pull-teams of cultivators to haul a traction trebuchet beam with matched strength and to let go as one body.

title: A Field Manual for Rough Ground
summary: Shows how to level and brace a trebuchet on a slope or in mud and keep its throw true afterwards.

title: Workbook of Windage and Wet Rope
summary: Trains cultivators to read crosswind and damp cable and to correct a trebuchet's aim and winding for both.

title: Treatise on the Mixed Shot Load
summary: Teaches filling a sling pouch with many small stones so the throw scatters over a field of ranks instead of one point.
